items.notes: 03 §7.3: sacked eleven days before the trial.

body: Eleven days out, they let him go. Four games without a win and a home crowd of nine hundred.
He had watched you twice. He had used the word interesting, and he had meant it enough to say it to Ruslan.

choices.outcome_text: He answers in a week. He is at his brother's in Voronezh and he wishes you luck, and that is all there is.

choices.text: Take his number out of your phone.
choices.outcome_text: It takes two seconds. You find yourself sitting on the bench afterwards for longer than that.

items.notes: 08 §8: the club is bought and the new owner brings players with him.

body: The club has a new owner. He has a concrete business and four players he likes.
Two of them play where you play. Nobody at the club knew until the photographs went up on the site.

choices.outcome_text: He takes the call in a car park. He says give it a month. A month is the whole window.
One of them is thirty-one and has been at six clubs. You watch four minutes of him and stop.

body: The scan is on a screen turned half away from you. The doctor points at a grey area with a pen.
He says it is old and it is not dangerous. He says at your age they take the view they take.

choices.text: Ask to see the screen properly.
choices.outcome_text: He turns it. You look at it for a while and it is a grey area on a screen.
The corridor has a laminated sign about the correct order of documents. You read all of it.

items.notes: 08 §8: the Vostok reforms, distance as a structural barrier.

body: The connection at Kamensk was forty minutes and the first bus was eighty minutes late.
You arrive at ten past two in the afternoon. The session was at eleven and it is over, and everyone is friendly about it.

choices.text: Ask if you can stay for tomorrow.
choices.outcome_text: There is no tomorrow. They are away on Wednesday and the squad went in this morning.
It leaves at 18:40 and you sit in the station for four hours with your bag on your knees.

body: The word is honest. They have watched enough of you to be specific, and they are.
It is the first time anyone has been specific in four years and it is not the way you wanted it.

choices.outcome_text: Four things, in the back of the notebook you use for bus times. Two of them you can fix.
He walks you as far as the gate, which is further than he had to.
